name: Hype Cut
tagline: TikTok retention cut: hook from frame 1, karaoke captions with a yellow word, punch-ins, stamps.

motion.direction: Retention cut. The first word gets a 1–2 word slam (`posterText`, anim pop, 150–220 px). A `zoom` punch-in every 3–4 s on the thing being named (`propPunchIn` when it is a prop). `stamp` on every verdict word, `chips` for lists, `counter`s racing to the number, `lockCard` tease early and a `reveal` on the payoff, `feedPhone` if scrolling or feeds are mentioned. Something changes every 1.5–2.5 s; boxed captions carry the speech so poster lines stay short. Hard cuts, whip camera, no serif, no fades.
